name: geopbf
description: Carry geometry as geometry. GeoPBF is a compact binary container for geospatial features, with Gint — a GPU-readable topology layer for instant point-in-polygon identify, shared-edge topology and choropleth painting. Converts GeoJSON / Shapefile / KML / KMZ / GPX / GML / FlatGeobuf / GeoPackage / File Geodatabase / GeoParquet / CSV / XLSX / TopoJSON in the browser via workers + WASM. Zero servers.
author: Kenji Yoshida <kenji.yoshida.home.2026@gmail.com>
